title: Life's A Voyage
author: Tatiana Ariola
description: Life's a voyage, and no one knows where they're going. Join us on the journey of life, business, creativity, and travel as we navigate the failures and successes and try not to get lost along the way. Hosted by Tat (and sometimes Adam), a young entrepreneur, photographer, and traveler.
